problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook page instead of an independent business website limits search engine optimization (SEO) potential and professional brand authority.
Absence of a dedicated booking or appointment-scheduling system on the digital storefront.
Lack of structured schema markup for local business and medical/dental services prevents rich snippets in search results.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring an integrated online booking system for dental consultations.
Implement local SEO strategies targeting Manila-based dental patients looking for specific procedures like orthodontics or cleaning.
Showcase patient testimonials and before-and-after smile galleries prominently to increase conversion rates.
audit.summary: UrbanDent Dental Clinic currently depends on a social media profile rather than a dedicated business website, restricting their digital footprint, appointment booking efficiency, and local search visibility in Manila.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on UrbanDent's online booking
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking up dental options in Manila and came across UrbanDent's Facebook page. It’s clear from your patient reviews that you take great care of people, but relying purely on social media can make it tough for new patients to find you on Google, especially without a dedicated booking link.

Without an easy way for patients to schedule appointments directly, you're likely losing out on people who prefer booking late at night or on their phones.

We put together a quick, live demo of what a simple website and booking system could look like for UrbanDent.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Warmly,

[Your Name]

During the first visit, we informed her that root canal treatment was a possible treatment option; however, the root canal procedure itself was not scheduled to be performed during that appointment.  Ms. Pegah Ameri was informed during the time of appointment booking that the schedule was for a check-up/ consultation only. Our team waited approximately 45 minutes before starting the consultation during the visit due to the patient's personal concerns. Despite the delay and the succeeding patient's scheduled appointment, we continued with the consultation, completed the necessary assessment, and assisted her with the panoramic X-ray. For the second appointment, which was scheduled for the root canal procedure, our clinic sent reminders requesting that she arrive on time to avoid cancellation of the appointment. Despite the cancellation of the dental procedure, our team prepared the requested treatment plan and was prepared to assist them further, but we were unable to do so under the circumstances.

We understand that traffic, weather conditions, and other unforeseen circumstances can cause delays, and we regret any inconvenience this may have caused. At the same time, we ask for the same consideration for our doctors, staff, and other patients, whose appointments are also scheduled in advance and arrive on time.

We remain committed to providing our patients with professional care, clear communication, and proper appointment management. As previously communicated, we also fulfilled our commitment to process your request for the refund and provide the requested radiographs.

We respect every patient's right to share their experience and provide feedback. We only hope that the circumstances are presented accurately and in their proper context.

problems.issue: Website relies entirely on client-side JavaScript rendering via Wix without server-side rendered (SSR) content visible in the initial HTML payload.
problems.impact: Search engine crawlers (SEO) may struggle to properly index the site content, potentially lowering visibility in local search results.

problems.issue: Heavy dependency on multiple external polyfill scripts and legacy asset bundles loaded in the document head.
problems.impact: Increases initial page load latency and Time to Interactive (TTI), which can negatively impact user experience and mobile conversion rates.

opportunities: Optimize Core Web Vitals by auditing Wix plugin scripts and deferring non-essential polyfills.
Implement robust local SEO schema markup tailored for dental clinics to capture high-intent local search traffic.
Ensure clear, accessible calls-to-action (like 'Book Appointment') are prioritized above the fold in the rendered client view.
audit.summary: The website for Adent Dental Clinic operates on the Wix platform, utilizing heavy client-side rendering. While functional, the lack of server-rendered markup in the primary payload poses potential risks for search engine optimization and initial load performance.

outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking up dental clinics in Makati and came across A. Dent's site. It’s great to see your practice online, but I noticed a couple of technical snags under the hood.

Because the site relies entirely on client-side rendering through Wix, search engine crawlers struggle to properly read your pages—which might be costing you local patients searching on Google. Plus, heavy legacy scripts in the header are slowing down your load times on mobile.

We put together a quick, lightweight demo showing how these can be fixed for better speed and visibility.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,

[Your Name]
